description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships
You are comfortable using spreadsheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, or similar tools
You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication
You are interested in TikTok, creators, social commerce, books, media, or ecommerce




Bonus Points
Experience with TikTok Shop
Experience with influencer or affiliate programs
Experience working with U.S.-based creators
Experience in ecommerce or social commerce
Experience managing launch campaigns
Experience creating creator briefs or campaign briefs
Familiarity with BookTok, publishing, books, or media
Experience in a fast-moving startup environment
Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

About the job

Description

We are looking for a Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager for the Amazon Mexico business to drive growth for the Amazon Mexico Stores via automated (performance) marketing channels.

We are looking for a marketing leader who likes to use technology to improve the customer experience and make a meaningful difference to how our customers shop online. At Amazon, we aim to become Earth’s most Customer-Centric Company and continue to innovate the way we engage with our customers through various marketing programs.

Critical missions of Paid Social and Creators team in Mexico are 1) to drive traffic and create innovative marketing programs in existing channels to make Amazon the most preferred shopping and entertainment destination for customers in Mexico, 2) to provide the best-in-class customer experience with highly personalized engaging marketing programs to help our customers make purchasing decisions, 3) to educate and attract new customers to Amazon overall and specific offerings, and 4) to dive deep into data to gain insights and optimize marketing programs.

The Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager plays a critical role in realizing these missions, leading various online marketing functions for Amazon.com.mx, managing and improving the marketing programs in Social Media Advertising and Creators Marketing. They will also be responsible for driving innovation by owning internally developed automated marketing products and platforms by leveraging the Amazon’s technologies. This position is one of the key senior roles in the Mexico Marketing and Prime organization. The impact of this role is significant, accounting for a large percentage of all amazon.com.mx new customers, traffic and sales. The position reports to the Head of Automated Marketing for Amazon Mexico.

Key job responsibilities


 Lead formulation of Social and Creators strategies for Mexico, including identifying key target customer segments, competitive environment, our program’s strengths and areas to invest for future innovations
 Manage, improve and innovate marketing programs, such as Automated Invoicing solutions, Social Ads, creators products.
 Drive topline while managing marketing budget, meeting ROI criteria.
 Deliver results and help Amazon meet or exceed goals in sales, profitability, new customers, and various high-value Amazon programs such as Prime membership.
 Work directly with tech teams across Amazon to define and get new development projects on tech roadmap
 Develop strong relationships and work collaboratively with the category leadership to achieve shared goals.
 Work closely with central Automated Marketing stakeholders and technical resources to ensure the company’s infrastructure, architecture, and site features support and enhance the effectiveness of Automated Marketing team’s programs.
 Identify the unique opportunities and challenges in Mexico by leveraging learnings from customer insights
 Share and learn worldwide best practices to mutually help worldwide marketing teams achieve goals.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
 Experience in delivering end-to-end customer research studies, including study design, fieldwork (qualitative research moderation and survey execution), analysis, recommendations, reporting and presentation of results to senior leadership


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. About the job

Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients' lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.

Job Summary

The Brand Lead, Hematology is a strategic and executional leader responsible for driving the commercialization of Reblozyl (Luspatercept) and support for the next launches in Cell Therapy in the market. This individual will develop and implement integrated brand strategies that reflect a deep understanding of the public and private healthcare market dynamics, including specialty and high-complexity treatment settings. As part of the BMS Hematology Commercial team, this role plays a pivotal part in ensuring speed to patients, cross-functional alignment, and business excellence in a highly competitive therapeutic landscape.

Job Description

The Brand Lead reports to the Franchise Lead, Hematology, and serves as the brand strategy owner for the hematology portfolio and supports the launch of Cell Therapies. This individual will be the orchestrator of a cross-functional brand team, translating scientific and clinical evidence into compelling commercial strategies that resonate with hematologists, multidisciplinary teams, and healthcare institutions across both public (institutional/government) and private market segments.

We are seeking a results-driven, patient-centered professional, passionate about hematology and experienced in specialty/high-complexity product management, who brings strong strategic acumen, executional discipline, and proven launch excellence capabilities aligned with the BMS Commercialization Model.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Commercialization


Lead the development and execution of the annual brand plan for Reblozyl and Cell Therapies, including situation analysis, strategic imperatives, tactical mix, and investment allocation.
Define and manage the brand positioning, messaging architecture, and value proposition for Reblozyl and Cell Therapies across all customer segments.
Drive Reblozyl and Cell Therapies launch readiness and execution, coordinating all pre-launch and launch activities across commercial, medical, market access, regulatory, and supply functions.
Develop and monitor brand performance KPIs, adjusting strategies and tactics based on market insights and competitive intelligence.
Digital Innovation & Omnichannel Excellence: Proven ability to lead integrated omnichannel campaigns that seamlessly connect field force, digital, and medical channels to deliver a consistent and impactful brand experience; hands-on experience applying Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics tools to anticipate market trends, improve customer segmentation, and drive data-informed commercial decisions in specialty hematology.


Market Insights & Customer Understanding


Lead market research and analytics initiatives to generate deep understanding of the hematology landscape, unmet needs, patient journey, and stakeholder dynamics.
Map and analyze public market (IMSS, ISSSTE, IMSS Bienestar) dynamics, formulary processes, institutional protocols, and purchasing cycles.
Monitor private market dynamics including managed care, hematology networks, key hematology centers, and high-specialty hospitals.
Integrate insights from field-based teams, medical affairs, and market access to continuously evolve brand strategies.


Cross-Functional Leadership


Lead and energize the Brand Team (TAS/Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Patient Advocacy, Finance) ensuring cohesive strategy and aligned execution.
Partner with Medical Affairs to ensure the scientific platform supports commercial objectives within compliance guidelines.
Collaborate with Market Access to develop value-based tools and evidence strategies for institutional access (public tenders, CBNSS inclusion).
Work closely with the global brand team to align local strategy with global brand direction.


Launch Excellence


Own and drive the Hematology pipeline launch plan, from pre-launch readiness assessment to first patient use and post-launch tracking.
Lead development of launch promotional tools, training materials, and go-to-market plans for Hematology pipeline across public and private channels.
Orchestrate cross-functional launch readiness reviews (LRR) and milestone tracking.
Develop and monitor launch KPIs and adapt tactics as needed to ensure a successful market entry.


Operational Excellence & Compliance


Ensure all brand activities are executed in full compliance with BMS policies, local regulations, and industry codes (COFEPRIS, Código de Ética de la Industria Farmacéutica).
Manage brand budget with accountability, ensuring resource allocation maximizes ROI and strategic priorities.

title: Partnerships & Growth Manager
description:
About the job

About Zipmi 

Zipmi is reimagining the US visa application experience. Our flagship product guides applicants through the DS-160 — the required nonimmigrant visa form — making a notoriously complex government process fast, accurate, and stress-free. We're a fast-moving team building at the intersection of immigration, technology, and global mobility.




The Role 

We're looking for a Partnerships & Growth Manager to build and own Zipmi's external partnership ecosystem. This is a foundational role — you'll be the first person dedicated to partnerships at Zipmi, which means you'll be building the playbook from scratch.

Your focus will be split across two tracks: forging relationships with government-adjacent organizations and institutions that serve visa applicants, and identifying brand and commercial partners who can drive distribution and trust at scale.

This role sits at the intersection of business development, marketing, and strategy. It's ideal for someone who is equally comfortable in a government affairs meeting and a startup pitch room. You will work closely with our marketing team, building critical relationships in our go-to-market strategy across Brazil and Mexico. 


What You'll Do 

Government & Institutional Partnerships

• Identify and build relationships with US embassies, consulates, and State Department-adjacent organizations that interact with visa applicants

• Partner with international student offices at universities and colleges to position Zipmi as a recommended resource for F-1 and J-1 applicants

• Develop relationships with immigration attorneys, law firms, and accredited representatives who advise DS-160 applicants

• Engage with foreign government tourism and trade offices, expat organizations, and international chambers of commerce

• Navigate compliance and regulatory considerations to ensure all partnerships meet legal and ethical standards

Brand & Commercial Partnerships

• Identify and close partnerships with travel brands, airlines, hospitality/resort brands, international relocation companies, and HR/mobility platforms whose customers overlap with visa applicants

• Build co-marketing programs that put Zipmi in front of applicants at the moment they need it most

• Develop affiliate and referral structures that create scalable, measurable distribution

• Work with employers and HR teams who sponsor international workers and support visa applications as part of the relocation process

Strategy & Operations

• Own the full partnership lifecycle from prospecting and outreach through negotiation, contracting, and ongoing relationship management

• Build and maintain a partnership pipeline and report regularly on activity, conversion, and revenue impact

• Collaborate with the product and marketing teams to develop partner-facing materials, co-branded content, and integration workflows

• Represent Zipmi at relevant industry conferences, immigration events, and trade shows




What We're Looking For 

• 4–7 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or growth — ideally at a startup or in a regulated industry

• Proven track record of building partnerships from scratch and closing deals with both institutional and commercial partners

• Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships — particularly with government or quasi-government organizations

• Strong communicator and relationship builder — you can tailor your pitch to a university administrator, a consulate official, and a CMO in the same week

• Self-starter who thrives with ambiguity and can build structure where none exists

• Experience in immigration, legaltech, fintech, or government services is a strong plus

• Existing relationships in the immigration, education, hospitality and global mobility space are a significant advantage




What You'll Get 

• The opportunity to build and own an entirely new function at a company tackling a massive, underserved market

• Competitive salary 

• Remote-friendly culture with a team that moves fast and takes ownership seriously

title: Fleet Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Para seguir creciendo necesitamos algo fundamental: más capacidad en los mercados correctos. Hoy esos mercados son León-Querétaro, Puebla y Monterrey.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Specialist que viva en alguna de estas plazas y expanda nuestra red de transportistas desde ahí. Identificarás flotas y hombres-camión, negociarás condiciones y cerrarás afiliaciones, hasta lograr que cada unidad pase de ser una oportunidad comercial a capacidad activa dentro de PartRunner.




Es un rol 100% remoto y con ownership end to end. Construyes tu propio pipeline, lo trabajas y respondes por él hasta que las unidades están rodando.




Lo que harás

1. Prospección y Generación de Pipeline

Prospectar y reclutar hombres-camión y flotas PyME en distintos estados de México.

Ejecutar estrategias de prospección digital enfocadas en fletes: redes sociales, bases de datos, campañas y marketplaces del sector.

Construir y mantener tu propio pipeline en CRM, con seguimiento disciplinado por etapa.

Identificar y abrir nuevas fuentes de captación, no solo trabajar las existentes.




2. Negociación y Cierre de Afiliaciones

Negociar condiciones comerciales con transportistas y flotas, equilibrando competitividad y rentabilidad para el negocio.

Cerrar afiliaciones y asegurar la firma de las condiciones acordadas.

Gestionar objeciones de fondo: tarifas, tiempos de pago, garantías, volumen comprometido.

Trabajo en campo cuando acelere cierres estratégicos.




3. Activación y Onboarding de Unidades

Dar seguimiento puntual al proceso de onboarding dentro de la plataforma hasta la activación real de cada unidad.

Asegurar que la documentación y los requisitos de alta estén completos y en tiempo.

Reducir el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.




4. Relación con Transportistas y Retención

Mantener comunicación constante con proveedores vía WhatsApp, llamadas, correo y reuniones presenciales.

Detectar señales tempranas de churn y actuar antes de perder la unidad.

Ser el punto de contacto comercial de las flotas que traes a la red.

Levantar hacia el equipo interno lo que la red necesita para quedarse.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Estrategia de Crecimiento

Cumplir KPIs comerciales semanales y mensuales de adquisición, activación y retención.

Analizar métricas de desempeño para optimizar tasas de conversión y retención por estado, tipo de unidad y canal de captación.

Desarrollar estrategias para ampliar la red en mercados con déficit de capacidad.

Coordinar con Marketing para impulsar campañas de captación y aportar el input de campo que las haga funcionar.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

2+ años de experiencia en adquisición, onboarding o ventas.

2+ años en industria de transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

Experiencia comprobable en ventas y negociación, con números que la respalden.

Manejo de CRM y seguimiento estructurado de pipeline comercial.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y cierre.




Nice to Have

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Experiencia previa en startups.

Experiencia en trabajo de campo con transportistas.




Competencias Clave

Tienes pensamiento crítico: cuestionas el proceso cuando no está siendo funcional y propones mejoras.

Organización y capacidad de multitarea real, con varias negociaciones abiertas a la vez.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.




En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

title: Productor de Contenido (video + redes sociales)
description:
About the job

Productor de Contenido (video + redes sociales) — Clinova: Híbrido con salidas a grabación · 14,000 MXN – 22,000 MXN brutos según experiencia.
Sobre nosotros Clinova construye herramientas de inteligencia artificial para que los médicos en México dejen de llevarse las notas clínicas a su casa. Somos un equipo muy pequeño en etapa temprana y estamos por abrir nuestra voz en redes: humor de gremio, cero corporativo, hecho para que un médico se ría y etiquete a su colega.
Quién eres Alguien que graba, edita y publica. Que ve un reel y ya sabe por qué funcionó el primer segundo. Que se siente cómodo llegando a un consultorio con un médico que tiene 20 minutos entre pacientes y saliendo de ahí con material que sirve. Que tiene opinión sobre qué publicar, no solo manos para ejecutarlo.
Qué vas a hacer · Producir de punta a punta el contenido en video de Clinova: idea, guion, grabación en sitio, edición, subtitulado y publicación. · Grabar en consultorios, clínicas, eventos médicos y en nuestras propias sesiones — con presencia física en CDMX y área metropolitana. · Crear piezas estáticas: carruseles, memes y gráficos, dentro de un sistema visual ya definido. · Implementar y mantener automatizaciones de redes (respuestas automáticas por DM, programación, reportes). No respondes mensajes uno por uno; construyes el sistema que lo hace. · Sentarte con el fundador en la planeación quincenal de contenido: traer ideas, ganchos y lecturas de métricas. · Mantener ordenado el archivo de material y los proyectos editables.
Lo que buscamos · 2 a 4 años produciendo contenido para marcas o cuentas con audiencia real (agencia, marca propia, freelance — nos da igual el formato). · Portafolio con video vertical: reels, TikToks o shorts. Es el requisito principal; el CV importa poco. · Dominio de Premiere, DaVinci o CapCut, y de Figma o Canva. · Audio y luz decentes con equipo ligero. No necesitas ser director de fotografía; sí necesitas que se escuche bien. · Capacidad de trabajar con poca supervisión y entregar en tiempos cortos. · Base en CDMX y disponibilidad para trasladarte a grabaciones.
Suma puntos · Manejo de ManyChat, Metricool, Buffer, Make o Zapier. · Escribir bien y con humor en español mexicano. · Haber construido una cuenta propia desde cero, del tamaño que sea.
Lo que este puesto NO es No es atención al cliente ni responder mensajes todo el día. No es diseño de identidad de marca. No es compra de medios.
Condiciones · Sueldo de $14,000 a $22,000 MXN brutos mensuales según experiencia, más apoyo de traslados y renta de equipo si trabajas con el tuyo. · Primeros 3 meses por honorarios, con paso a nómina formal (IMSS y prestaciones de ley) a partir del cuarto mes. Te lo decimos claro desde ahora. · Horario flexible con días de grabación agendados con anticipación. · Licencias y herramientas por nuestra cuenta. · Trabajarás directamente con el fundador y tu trabajo será la cara pública de la empresa.
Confidencialidad Trabajamos cerca de médicos y de información sensible. Firmarás un acuerdo de confidencialidad y seguirás reglas estrictas: nunca se graba a un paciente, una pantalla con datos clínicos ni el audio de una consulta.
Cómo postularte Llena este formulario https://forms.gle/uceotW2VVd3kPJSf6. Nos importan tres cosas: (1) el link a tu portafolio o a tu cuenta, (2) un video que hayas hecho completo —grabado y editado por ti— con 3 líneas sobre qué harías distinto hoy, y (3) cómo automatizarías responder 50 mensajes directos idénticos al día. Hay una prueba práctica pagada como parte del proceso. No pedimos trabajo gratis.

title: Fleet Acquisition Supervisor
description:
About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Hoy el reto es construir capacidad instalada en los mercados correctos, con un equipo que replique el método en varias plazas al mismo tiempo.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Supervisor que construya la capacidad de transporte para una de nuestras cuentas de mayor volumen: una operación de e-commerce a escala nacional, con estándares de servicio altos y crecimiento sostenido.

Vas a dirigir a un equipo de negociadores regionales, cerrar las cuentas de mayor peso y construir la capacidad antes de que la demanda la pida.




El desafío

Este no es un rol de gestión de proveedores ni de administración de equipo a distancia. Es comercial, con responsabilidad sobre la capacidad de toda la red.

Del otro lado hay una cuenta que no espera. Cuando la demanda sube, la capacidad tiene que estar. Tu trabajo es que el equipo la construya con anticipación, no con urgencia, y que lo que funciona en una plaza se vuelva método replicable en las demás.




Lo que harás

1. Liderazgo y Desarrollo del Equipo Comercial

Supervisar, coordinar y desarrollar al equipo de negociadores regionales.

Asignar territorios, metas y prioridades según el déficit de capacidad de cada mercado.

Realizar sesiones semanales de pipeline review: avance por etapa, calidad de prospección y riesgos de cierre.

Detectar brechas de desempeño e implementar planes de desarrollo con objetivos observables.

Ser el primer nivel de escalación en negociaciones complejas o condiciones fuera de estándar.




2. Estrategia de Cobertura y Crecimiento de Red

Traducir la demanda proyectada de la cuenta en objetivos concretos de adquisición: cuántas unidades, de qué tipo, en qué ciudad y para cuándo.

Anticipar picos estacionales y campañas, asegurando capacidad disponible antes de que se necesite.

Priorizar plazas y segmentos de flota según el déficit real de capacidad, no según facilidad de cierre.

Diseñar y estandarizar el método de prospección para que sea replicable por cualquier integrante del equipo.

Abrir nuevos canales de captación y medir su rendimiento contra los existentes.




3. Ejecución Comercial Directa

Gestionar personalmente la negociación con flotas de alto volumen y contrapartes estratégicas.

Mantener cuota individual en las cuentas de mayor impacto para el negocio.

Acompañar a los negociadores en cierres críticos y en campo cuando el tamaño de la operación lo amerite.




4. Economics de la Red

Negociar y sostener condiciones que equilibren competitividad para el transportista y rentabilidad para PartRunner.

Monitorear el costo de adquisición por unidad activa y el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.

Identificar en qué plazas se está pagando de más por capacidad y proponer ajustes.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Digital

Monitorear indicadores de adquisición, activación y retención por plaza, tipo de unidad y canal.

Detectar patrones de churn de transportistas antes de que impacten la capacidad disponible.

Identificar tareas manuales del proceso de afiliación y traducirlas en requerimientos accionables para producto y sistemas.

Asegurar la disciplina de registro en CRM del equipo completo: sin dato, la etapa no existe.




6. Reporteo y Mejora Continua

Generar y presentar reportes semanales y mensuales por mercado con KPIs clave: unidades afiliadas · % activación · tiempo a primer viaje · costo de adquisición · % retención a 90 días.

Reportar el estado de capacidad frente a los compromisos de servicio de la cuenta, con alertas tempranas cuando un mercado vaya corto.

Presentar hallazgos e iniciativas a dirección de forma clara y basada en datos.

Realizar análisis post-mortem de plazas que no alcanzaron objetivo y proponer correcciones concretas.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

3+ años de experiencia en adquisición, ventas o desarrollo de proveedores.

3+ años en transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

1+ año liderando equipos comerciales, con responsabilidad sobre la meta del equipo y no solo la propia.

Experiencia negociando con flotas o transportistas de alto volumen.

Manejo de CRM y disciplina de gestión de pipeline, propia y de equipo.

Dominio intermedio-avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets y experiencia elaborando reportes ejecutivos.

Residir en Guadalajara o zona metropolitana.

Disponibilidad para viaje foráneo eventual a las plazas del equipo.




Nice to Have

Experiencia abriendo plazas o mercados nuevos desde cero.

Experiencia previa en startups o entornos de alto crecimiento.

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Manejo de herramientas de BI (Power BI, Looker, Google Data Studio).




Competencias Clave

Tomas decisiones rápidas con criterio y datos.

Alto nivel de seguimiento y cierre: no dejas hilos sueltos, ni tuyos ni del equipo.

Te autogestionas: en remoto y sin supervisión presencial, sostienes tu ritmo y el de tu equipo.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + esquema de bonos por desempeño + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto. 




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.







En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

title: Administrador de redes
description:
About the job

FITAL XYZ busca un Trafficker Digital para tomar el control total de nuestra pauta en Meta Ads y TikTok Ads. El objetivo del puesto es uno solo y es medible: generar leads calificados a un costo por cita agendada rentable.




No buscamos a alguien que publique contenido. Buscamos a quien administre presupuesto, lea datos y tome decisiones.




Responsabilidades

• Planear, configurar y optimizar campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads y TikTok Ads.

• Administrar el presupuesto diario y reasignarlo según el costo por lead y por cita agendada.

• Configurar y mantener la infraestructura de medición: Business Manager, Business Center, píxeles, Conversions API y Events API.

• Construir y mantener la conexión entre las plataformas y el CRM, y devolver las señales de calidad de lead para optimizar por cierre y no solo por volumen.

• Diseñar y probar formularios instantáneos, ángulos creativos y ganchos, sosteniendo una cadencia de 8 a 12 creativos nuevos al mes.

• Escribir guiones y briefs creativos para video vertical nativo.

• Entregar un reporte semanal con gasto, CPL, citas agendadas y costo por cita, junto con las decisiones que se derivan de esos números.

• Trabajar de la mano con el equipo comercial para verificar la calidad real de los leads.




Requisitos

• Mínimo 2 años administrando presupuesto propio en Meta Ads y al menos 1 año en TikTok Ads.

• Experiencia comprobable en campañas de generación de leads, no únicamente en e-commerce o alcance.

• Dominio de Meta Business Manager y TikTok Business Center a nivel administrador.

• Conocimiento práctico de píxel, Conversions API, eventos, UTMs y atribución.

• Capacidad de leer un reporte y explicar por qué subió el CPL: CPM, CTR o tasa de envío de formulario.

• Manejo de al menos un CRM y de herramientas de automatización.

• Criterio creativo: saber qué hace que un video funcione en TikTok y qué no.

• Disponibilidad para trabajo presencial en Azcapotzalco, Ciudad de México.




Deseable

• Experiencia en negocios de servicios con venta por llamada o cita.

• Edición básica de video vertical.

• Manejo de Looker Studio u hojas de cálculo avanzadas para reportería.

• Experiencia con Google Ads.




Ofrecemos

• Sueldo mensual: [definir rango].

• [Esquema de bonos por resultados, si aplica].

• [Prestaciones].

• Presupuesto de pauta real que administrar desde el primer mes.

• Autonomía sobre la estrategia y acceso directo a dirección, sin capas intermedias.




Proceso de selección

Al postular, incluye en tu mensaje tres datos: 1) el presupuesto mensual más alto que hayas administrado, 2) tu CPL promedio y en qué industria lo lograste, y 3) qué harías en tus primeros 30 días con una cuenta nueva. Las postulaciones que no incluyan esta información no avanzan.

title: Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket — Tecnología HIFU | Remoto | $3,200–$6,400 USD/mes en inbound + 10% outbound
description:
About the job

¿Sabes conducir una videollamada comercial, descubrir la necesidad real de un negocio y convertir una oportunidad de alto valor en una venta?




En Ultrasonic ampliamos nuestro equipo comercial internacional. Buscamos un/a Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket con experiencia real en cierre consultivo para trabajar con clínicas estéticas, centros de belleza y spas médicos en España, México y Estados Unidos.

No vendemos cursos ni servicios abstractos. Comercializamos Ultrasonic 12D, una plataforma de tecnología HIFU para tratamientos médico-estéticos de alto valor, dentro de un modelo llave en mano que combina tecnología, formación para el cliente y marketing para impulsar la demanda.

Tu misión es clara: recibir oportunidades comerciales reales, entender el negocio del prospecto, presentar la solución, construir una propuesta a medida y convertir la conversación en una venta cobrada.


Lo que hace diferente esta posición

Recibirás leads reales procedentes de campañas de marketing activas. Ultrasonic invierte en captación digital, retargeting y generación de demanda. No empiezas con una lista fría sin contexto: trabajas oportunidades que ya han mostrado interés y que necesitan una conversación comercial profesional para avanzar.

Tendrás un equipo de Setters profesionales agendando reuniones calificadas para ti. El equipo de setting identifica necesidad, valida información clave, nutre al prospecto con los materiales necesarios y confirma la asistencia antes de transferirte la reunión. Tu foco está donde aporta más valor: diagnosticar, presentar, resolver objeciones y cerrar.

Tu trabajo es procesar y convertir oportunidades en venta. No buscamos a alguien que haga presentaciones genéricas o deje propuestas sin seguimiento. Buscamos un Closer que domine la conversación de negocio, demuestre el retorno de inversión con los números del propio cliente y lleve cada oportunidad a una decisión concreta.

Tendrás onboarding, academia y dirección comercial. Recibirás configuración de CRM y herramientas, acceso a la academia de producto, dossier comercial, casos reales, configurador de propuestas, scripts, roleplays y sesiones de coaching con Dirección Comercial. El acceso a reuniones reales llega cuando demuestras en roleplay que puedes ejecutar el método, no cuando simplemente han pasado unos días.


Un sistema de comisiones diseñado para premiar el cierre

Es una posición 100% a comisión, sin salario base y sin techo artificial de ingresos. La lógica es directa: cuanto mejor cierras, más te beneficia el sistema.

En operaciones inbound, las primeras cuatro ventas del mes generan una comisión del 5%. Al cerrar la quinta venta, la comisión sube al 8% y se recalcula de forma retroactiva sobre todas las ventas inbound de ese mes. Con un ticket medio de referencia de $8,000 USD, cuatro ventas representan $1,600 USD; cinco ventas activan $3,200 USD; siete ventas equivalen a $4,480 USD y diez ventas a $6,400 USD.

Si generas tus propias oportunidades mediante prospección outbound, cobras un 10% flat por cada operación cerrada. Con cinco ventas inbound y dos operaciones outbound, el escenario de referencia alcanza $4,800 USD en comisiones.

El detalle completo del sistema, los requisitos de validación, la atribución de ventas, los objetivos y las condiciones operativas se muestra en la web antes de que tomes ninguna decisión.


El perfil que buscamos

Buscamos una persona con al menos un año de experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B, high-ticket, tecnología, salud, estética o entornos consultivos. Debe saber conducir una videollamada profesional, escuchar antes de presentar, usar un CRM con disciplina y manejar objeciones sin necesidad de improvisar promesas imposibles.

Necesitas español nativo o nivel profesional, ordenador propio, conexión estable, cámara y disposición para grabar reuniones como parte del proceso de calidad y coaching. El inglés es un plus para oportunidades en Estados Unidos. La relación es mercantil, por lo que debes poder emitir factura como autónomo/a, freelance o empresa.

Valoramos especialmente a quien sabe vender retorno, no descuento. Si entiendes que una clínica no compra una máquina sino una nueva línea de facturación, vas a entender muy rápido la propuesta de Ultrasonic.


Proceso de selección

El proceso es directo: registro en la web, vídeo de presentación, vídeo pitch de producto, entrevista por videollamada con roleplay, propuesta de incorporación y onboarding.

¿Te interesa cerrar ventas de alto valor con producto real, campañas activas, reuniones calificadas y un sistema de comisiones que escala a tu favor?




Haz clic en “Solicitar empleo”. Accederás a la web con toda la información detallada del puesto, el modelo de comisiones, el proceso y el formulario de registro:

https://ventas.ultrasonic-pro.com

Hay oportunidades comerciales activas. Incorporación según proceso de selección.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s B2B organization serves a diverse range of institutional and professional clients, supported by a growing ecosystem of sales tools and customer relationship management platforms. As our business continues to scale, we are seeking an experienced CRM Product Manager to define and drive the product strategy for the tools and workflows that enable our sales teams.

You are comfortable navigating competing stakeholder priorities, turning ambiguous requests into well-defined product requirements, and making thoughtful trade-offs across multiple teams and platforms. You understand how sales organizations operate and can distinguish between product, process, data, and technology challenges.

About the job




Customer Service




UBICACIÓN

Celaya, Guanajuato, México — Presencial, tiempo completo




DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO




Alcansa es una empresa dedicada a la inyección de plástico para la industria automotriz, con clientes de talla internacional. Buscamos incorporar a un(a) Customer Service que se convierta en el punto de contacto entre Alcansa y nuestros clientes, garantizando el cumplimiento de sus requerimientos y sosteniendo relaciones comerciales sólidas y de largo plazo.




RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES




- Revisar y dar seguimiento a los requerimientos específicos de cada cliente (CSR).

- Dar seguimiento al cumplimiento de entregas (OTD) conforme a los programas de embarque.

- Liderar la elaboración y cierre de reportes 8D derivados de reclamos de cliente.

- Dar seguimiento a no conformidades y consolidar reportes de KPIs para el área.

- Revisar y dar seguimiento a scorecards de cliente, elaborando planes de acción cuando se requiera.

- Gestionar requerimientos especiales del cliente (cambios de empaque, etiquetado, logística o ingeniería).

- Dar seguimiento administrativo a reparaciones de molde y a la vida útil de herramentales (Tooling Lifetime).

- Elaborar reportes generales ante incidentes con cliente, incluyendo paros de línea o embarques especiales.

- Servir como enlace entre el cliente y las áreas internas de Calidad, Producción y Proyectos.




REQUISITOS




- 3 años de experiencia en Customer Service dentro de la industria automotriz (proveedores Tier 1 o Tier 2).

- Experiencia comprobable gestionando reclamos de cliente y reportes 8D de forma autónoma.

- Conocimiento de IATF 16949 aplicado a atención a cliente.

- Manejo de portales de cliente 

- Nivel de inglés intermedio, tanto escrito como verbal.

- Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio (tablas dinámicas, reportes).

- Disponibilidad para laborar de forma presencial en Celaya, Guanajuato.




SE VALORA ADICIONALMENTE

- Familiaridad con procesos de manufactura por inyección de plástico.




QUÉ OFRECE ALCANSA




- Incorporación a una empresa establecida en el sector automotriz, con proyectos vigentes de clientes reconocidos internacionalmente.

- Un rol con visibilidad directa ante Dirección y con impacto real en la relación comercial con el cliente.

- Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo, con oportunidad de crecimiento dentro de la organización.




Las personas interesadas que cumplan con el perfil pueden postularse a través de esta publicación.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

In your role within the Customer Support team, you will play a vital part in engaging with customers and overseeing Service Contracts to ensure that performance indicators are met while also contributing to project profitability and meeting regional sales objectives.

Responsibilities:


 Develop and maintain relationships with existing customers, leveraging customer intimacy to ensure renewals of Service Contracts and secure additional business.

 Engineering or Business Administration degree.

 Good business sense and good economical understanding of contracts.

 Wind turbine, Energy or Aircrfat industry experience would be considered.

Our commitment to a fair hiring.

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.

Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.

Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.

To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

About GrowthX AI

At GrowthX, we’re building the modern growth engine for marketing teams. Since launching in 2024, we've grown from concept to eight-figure annual revenue. To date, we've raised a $12M Series A led by Madrona Venture Group and we partner with 60+ companies ranging from high-growth startups to industry leaders like Lovable, Webflow, Ramp, Superhuman, Strapi, Abnormal Security, and Augment Code.

We’ve built something different: an operating system that unifies powerful AI workflows with forward-deployed experts to transform content into compounding organic growth. We’re building the growth infrastructure marketing teams wish they’d always had — the system that reliably turns context into strategy, strategy into execution, and execution into measurable growth.

We’re hiring an SEO Customer Success to own the most critical phase of the customer lifecycle: turning new customers into confident, long-term partners who see real growth and choose to expand with us.

This role is customer-facing, outcome-driven, and consultative. You are accountable for onboarding customers, leading early strategy and execution, and converting successful pilots or initial engagements into full-time contracts.

description:
About the job

Description

AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


 Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
 Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
 Candidates must be able to travel or commute to active data center sites as required by business needs.


Key job responsibilities

The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:


 Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
 Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
 Developing Career Paths for the employees and making updates in our internal tools.
 Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
 Ensure effective and efficient management of day-to-day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics

 Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation
 Manage and improve the workflows and through-put for data centers operations

 Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience


About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job




Descripción del puesto

En SITRES Latam y Bidur SAPI buscamos una persona que combine Growth Marketing, ejecución digital, creatividad e Inteligencia Artificial.




No buscamos únicamente a alguien que diseñe estrategias, coordine agencias o genere reportes. Buscamos una persona hands-on, capaz de detectar una oportunidad de crecimiento y llevarla desde la idea hasta la ejecución, medición y optimización.




Trabajarás con proyectos en industrias muy diferentes, desde tecnología industrial B2B hasta entretenimiento y experiencias B2C, utilizando IA y automatización como herramientas cotidianas para multiplicar tu capacidad de trabajo.




Tu objetivo será sencillo de explicar y difícil de ejecutar: generar crecimiento medible y construir sistemas que nos permitan hacer más con menos.




¿Qué harás?
Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias de generación de demanda y adquisición de clientes.
Crear, administrar y optimizar campañas en Meta Ads, Google Ads y otros canales digitales.
Diseñar y optimizar funnels de conversión y landing pages.
Crear contenido, imágenes, videos y materiales de marketing utilizando herramientas de IA y diseño.
Implementar automatizaciones de marketing, seguimiento y nurturing.
Conectar formularios, CRM, WhatsApp, email y otras plataformas para mejorar la gestión de leads.
Utilizar IA para segmentación, generación y personalización de contenido, análisis y optimización de campañas.
Diseñar y ejecutar experimentos A/B.
Analizar métricas como leads, CPL, CAC, conversión, ROAS y ventas.
Crear dashboards y reportes que permitan tomar decisiones rápidamente.
Identificar procesos repetitivos que puedan automatizarse utilizando IA.
Experimentar constantemente con nuevas herramientas, canales y formas de trabajar.
Trabajar directamente con el equipo comercial para convertir marketing en oportunidades reales de negocio.


Inteligencia Artificial

La IA no es un complemento de este puesto. Es una parte central del trabajo.

Buscamos alguien que ya utilice herramientas de inteligencia artificial de manera habitual para aumentar su productividad y capacidad de ejecución.

Nos interesa experiencia con herramientas como:

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini o equivalentes.
Herramientas de generación y edición de imágenes y video.
Canva, Adobe u otras plataformas de diseño.
Make, Zapier, n8n o herramientas similares de automatización.
CRM y automatización de marketing.
Google Analytics y herramientas de visualización de datos.

No esperamos que domines todas las herramientas.

Sí esperamos que tengas la curiosidad y capacidad necesarias para aprender rápidamente una nueva cuando el problema lo requiera.




¿Qué buscamos?
Experiencia práctica en Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing o Marketing Digital.
Experiencia administrando campañas digitales.
Conocimiento de funnels, landing pages y optimización de conversión.
Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.
Experiencia práctica utilizando IA generativa.
Capacidad para crear materiales gráficos y audiovisuales, directamente o utilizando IA.
Conocimientos de automatización.
Buen criterio visual y de comunicación.
Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma.
Mentalidad experimental: probar, medir, aprender y volver a ejecutar.
Capacidad para pasar de estrategia a ejecución sin depender constantemente de terceros.



Valoramos experiencia en startups, ecommerce, SaaS, agencias digitales o empresas donde hayas tenido que construir y ejecutar, no solamente coordinar.

Formación en marketing, comunicación, diseño, negocios, ingeniería o áreas relacionadas es bienvenida, pero valoramos más lo que sabes hacer que el nombre de tu carrera.

Experiencia sugerida: 2 a 6 años.




Perfil personal

Buscamos una persona:

Curiosa y autodidacta.
Muy ejecutora.
Analítica.
Creativa.
Organizada.
Autónoma.
Con iniciativa.
Cómoda experimentando.
Interesada genuinamente en inteligencia artificial y nuevas tecnologías.
Orientada a resultados comerciales, no solamente a métricas de marketing.




Qué ofrecemos
Posición de tiempo completo.
Trabajo presencial en Azcapotzalco, CDMX, con posibilidad de esquema híbrido.
Sueldo competitivo de acuerdo con experiencia y capacidades.
Compensación variable ligada a resultados.
Alto nivel de autonomía.
Participación en proyectos de tecnología, innovación y entretenimiento.
Posibilidad de construir procesos, automatizaciones y herramientas desde cero.
Un entorno donde experimentar con IA no solamente está permitido, sino que es parte del trabajo.




Nuestro proceso de selección

Queremos conocer lo que puedes hacer, no solamente lo que dice tu CV.

Como primera fase del proceso, después de tu postulación recibirás un ejercicio práctico.

Puedes y debes utilizar todas las herramientas de inteligencia artificial que consideres necesarias para resolverlo.

Nos interesará entender qué herramientas utilizaste, cómo las utilizaste, qué decisiones tomaste y qué lograste producir.

No queremos medir cuánto puedes hacer sin IA. Queremos descubrir cuánto más eres capaz de hacer gracias a ella.

About the job

About Cape.io

At Cape.io, we're not just keeping pace with the advertising industry. We're accelerating it.

We are a global technology company on a mission to eliminate the friction between creative and media. Cape.io is the first Intelligent Campaign Automation platform to unify the entire campaign lifecycle. By embedding AI and automated compliance from creative inception to activation, we empower brands to launch high-impact, compliant campaigns with unprecedented speed and intelligence.

Our platform is trusted by the world's top agencies and advertisers to control and distribute advertising content in over 100 countries. With over 230 employees across 21 offices—from London to the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific—we are fundamentally changing the way advertising works.




What you'll do

Own and streamline the end-to-end publishing setup across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, CM360, DV360, Snapchat and more - from reference campaigns to scalable automation.
Translate campaign requirements into robust Cape.io configurations, ensuring accurate mappings, naming conventions, asset structures and platform-specific compliance.
Test, validate and optimize publishing flows, identifying edge cases and improving reliability, performance and scalability across markets and formats.
Guide clients in adopting self-service workflows, providing hands-on support, clear documentation and best-practice setups that reduce manual intervention over time.

A detail-driven mindset with the ability to manage complex, highly configurable systems without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Experience with campaign operations, feed structures, automation logic or technical implementations in an ad tech or martech environment.
A proactive, solution-oriented attitude: comfortable testing, troubleshooting and working closely with clients to make sophisticated workflows feel simple.




About the Creative Automation solution

The challenge: Creative bottlenecks and manual Ad Ops are burning out teams and killing campaign performance. The endless cycle of revisions and trafficking keeps brands from scaling what works.

Our solution: Our team is solving this. We've built the all-in-one platform to produce, personalize, and launch high-performing ads for every channel—from social and display to video and DOOH. We unify creative and media workflows, enabling brands to go from a single master creative to unlimited, on-brand variations in minutes, not weeks.

Your impact: As part of this team, you will be at the heart of our mission to unleash creativity. You'll be empowering our clients to outperform the competition by building, selling, or supporting the tools that turn data into high-impact, personalized ads at scale.




Our DNA: How we work

Our values aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles that guide our decisions, actions, and interactions every day.

Move smart: Hesitation kills momentum. We combine speed with intelligence, turning complex challenges into automated solutions. Every experiment teaches us, every failure makes us stronger.
Define tomorrow: We're not here to meet expectations; we're here to reset them. Our mission demands unprecedented quality, security, and scale. We push the boundaries of what's possible.
Be better together: Success multiplies when shared. We step up, dig in, and make things better for each other. Through open collaboration and fierce support, we turn individual potential into collective achievement.
Change what’s possible: Creativity drives humanity forward. Our technology exists to amplify it, protect it, and let it soar. We remove barriers between great minds and great work.




Why join Cape.io?

Competitive salary and benefits package.

The opportunity to work on a market-leading product that is defining the future of advertising.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive, bilingual Social Media Engagement & Appointment Setting Specialist to help a growing U.S.-based business stay connected with its online community, respond to prospective clients, and convert conversations into appointments.




This is a hybrid role combining social media community engagement, lead follow-up, CRM management, appointment setting, and outbound calling.




This is not a traditional content-focused social media role. The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, whether through DMs, comments, WhatsApp, or phone calls, and knows how to turn conversations into meaningful business opportunities.




Key Responsibilities:

Monitor and respond to DMs, comments, messages, and inquiries across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Messenger, and WhatsApp.

Make outbound calls to prospective, previous, and existing CRM contacts to generate conversations and appointments.

title: Representante de servicio al cliente
description:
About the job




Representante de servicio a cliente 

(IN HOUSE) 

(EXPERIENCIA EN EMPRESAS DE MANUFACTURA O TANGIBLES)







Objetivo del puesto




Garantizar una experiencia de servicio excepcional mediante la gestión integral de las necesidades, requerimientos y oportunidades de los clientes, asegurando respuestas oportunas, seguimiento efectivo y cumplimiento de los compromisos establecidos.




Actuar como enlace estratégico entre el cliente y las áreas internas, anticipando necesidades, resolviendo incidencias y generando acciones que fortalezcan la satisfacción, fidelización y relación comercial con los clientes.







Principales responsabilidades




Gestionar de manera integral la atención y servicio al cliente, asegurando respuestas oportunas, claras y orientadas a la solución.




Comprender las necesidades y expectativas de cada cliente, anticipándose a sus requerimientos y proponiendo alternativas que mejoren su experiencia de servicio.




Dar seguimiento puntual a pedidos, requerimientos, cotizaciones, entregas, incidencias y compromisos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los acuerdos establecidos.




Coordinar con las diferentes áreas internas las acciones necesarias para atender los requerimientos del cliente y garantizar una respuesta eficiente.




Gestionar y resolver incidencias y reclamaciones, identificando la causa raíz, estableciendo acciones correctivas y dando seguimiento hasta su cierre satisfactorio.




Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes, informando oportunamente sobre avances, cambios, retrasos o cualquier situación que pueda impactar el servicio.




Dar seguimiento a indicadores de servicio, identificando tendencias, desviaciones y áreas de oportunidad para elevar el nivel de atención.




Analizar el comportamiento y necesidades de los clientes, detectando oportunidades de fortalecimiento de la relación comercial y posibles necesidades adicionales.




Mantener actualizada la información de clientes, pedidos, compromisos e incidencias, asegurando trazabilidad y disponibilidad de información para la toma de decisiones.




Participar activamente en la prevención de problemas, identificando riesgos en el servicio y escalando oportunamente aquellos casos que requieran intervención de otras áreas.




Construir relaciones de confianza con los clientes, convirtiéndose en un punto de contacto confiable y orientado a generar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.







Se busca un profesional con alta orientación al cliente, pensamiento analítico, sentido de urgencia y capacidad para resolver problemas.




Debe demostrar:




Alta orientación al servicio y satisfacción del cliente.




Enfoque en resultados y cumplimiento de compromisos.




Excelente comunicación verbal y escrita.




Capacidad para escuchar, comprender necesidades y generar soluciones.




Pensamiento analítico y capacidad para identificar causas raíz.




Proactividad y anticipación de necesidades.




Capacidad para gestionar situaciones de presión y clientes exigentes.




Organización y seguimiento disciplinado.




Capacidad para coordinar múltiples requerimientos simultáneamente.




Habilidad para negociar y manejar conflictos.




Sentido de urgencia y capacidad de respuesta.




Trabajo colaborativo con diferentes áreas.




Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer soluciones.




Orientación a la fidelización y construcción de relaciones de largo plazo.







Ofrecemos:




Sueldo Base.




Comisiones por retención y desarrollo de clientes.




Prestaciones superiores a la ley.




Plan de vida y carrera.
