description:
About the job

Reports to: Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director

Location: Mexico City

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years







ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is one of Mexico’s fastest-growing beauty brands, born at the intersection of beauty, culture, entertainment and community.




Founded by Anna Sarelly and Rémi Martini, SARELLY is building a new generation of beauty brand: culturally relevant, social-first and deeply connected to its community.

After becoming one of Mexico’s most exciting emerging beauty players, the brand is now entering its next chapter of growth, with major retail expansion across Mexico and the U.S.

Creativity is at the heart of everything we do—from product and packaging to campaigns, social content, retail experiences and entertainment. We are looking for someone who wants to help shape and protect a distinctive creative universe as SARELLY scales.







THE ROLE

SARELLY is looking for an Associate Art Director to ensure Anna Sarelly’s creative vision is consistently and flawlessly executed across every brand touchpoint. Reporting directly to Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director, this person will work closely with her and with our Marketing and Creative teams, acting as the bridge between big-picture creative direction and day-to-day execution—translating campaign ideas into cohesive visual systems, guiding multidisciplinary teams, leading art direction, and ensuring everything we put into the world feels unmistakably SARELLY.




This is not a purely managerial role. We are looking for someone who can think, direct and make.

Someone with exceptional visual taste who can lead a shoot, ensure the vision is executed properly across different touchpoints, build moodboards, challenge layouts, guide designers, give meaningful feedback on social content, and step into execution when needed.

Most importantly, this role serves as the primary creative filter between Anna and the execution teams—protecting her time by determining what requires her input versus what can be independently resolved within established creative and brand standards.

Ultimately, your job is simple: Protect the creative vision from concept to execution.







WHAT YOU’LL DO

01 — Translate Creative Vision

Work directly with Anna to transform high-level campaign ideas, cultural insights and creative concepts into actionable visual direction.

You will help define and maintain consistency across:

Campaign visual systems
Art direction
Content pillars
Social expressions
Photography and video execution
Retail adaptations
Graphic design systems
Social media assets
Launch moments
Digital assets
Creator executions

You should be able to take a big idea and understand how it lives across an entire brand ecosystem—ensuring it remains visually coherent at every touchpoint.







02 — Lead Creative Execution

Own the execution of creative projects from briefing through final delivery.

Translate creative direction into clear, precise briefs for designers, photographers, videographers, editors, content creators, agencies, freelancers and brand creative production partners.

Ensure teams understand not only what they need to create, but why it matters to the overall vision.

Coordinate execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining consistency, quality and delivery timelines.







03 — Art Direct

Lead and support art direction across all brand outputs, including:

Campaign shoots
Social content shoots
Product photography
Video content
E-commerce visuals
Creator content
Brand activations
Retail experiences

You should feel comfortable making decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, props, sets, typography, motion and visual storytelling.

You will sometimes co-lead major campaigns with Anna and other times independently lead executions while maintaining full alignment with her vision.







04 — Own Creative Quality Control

Act as a guardian of the SARELLY visual universe.

Review creative output across teams and provide clear, actionable feedback before work reaches Anna.

This includes:

Social content
Reels / TikToks
Photography
Video edits
Graphic design
Campaign adaptations
Retail assets
Creator content
Digital assets
Brand presentations

Your responsibility is not simply to ask:

“Does this look good?”

It is to ask:

“Does this feel like SARELLY—and does it stay true to our creative vision?”

Act as the final creative checkpoint before work is escalated, ensuring Anna is only involved in decisions that genuinely require strategic creative direction.







05 — Lead Social & Content Execution

Partner closely with Social, Content, Growth and Market Pods to translate global campaign ideas into culturally relevant, platform-native executions.

Act as the primary creative interface between the Creative Studio and Growth teams, translating global creative direction into clear execution frameworks that allow local teams to execute autonomously while respecting SARELLY’s creative and brand guidelines.

The role provides creative direction and quality standards for social content but does not own the overall social media calendar, channel strategy or publishing cadence, which remain the responsibility of the relevant Social/Growth teams.

You will:

Refine visual consistency across social outputs
Improve execution of tone of voice, edits and formats
Identify opportunities for stronger visual storytelling
Maintain brand coherence in fast-moving content cycles
Ensure local market adaptations remain faithful to the global creative vision

Balance brand-building with the speed and spontaneity social requires.







06 — Strengthen the Creative Team Through Execution

Help raise the overall executional standard of the team.

Give clear, direct and constructive feedback focused on craft and consistency.

Mentor designers and content creatives in:

Layout
Composition
Visual hierarchy
Brand consistency
Execution quality

Create clarity when teams feel stuck and ensure the creative vision is understood and properly translated at every level.

Coordinate and prioritize work across Brand Design, Photo & Video, freelance creative resources and production partners, ensuring the right people are focused on the highest-impact work.

The goal is not for everything to depend on you.

The goal is to ensure the entire team executes at a higher standard.







07 — Own Creative Studio Operations

Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Creative Studio.

You will be responsible for:

Creative calendar management
Project prioritization
Creative briefs
Review processes
Resource coordination
Delivery planning
Cross-functional communication

Own creative prioritization and capacity planning across internal teams, freelancers and external partners.

When resources cannot support every request, proactively bring forward recommendations and proposed trade-offs—not just problems—for alignment with Anna.

Protect the quality of output while ensuring the Creative Studio operates efficiently at scale.







08 — Stay Hands-On

We are looking for a creative leader who still loves making things.

You should be comfortable working in:

Adobe Creative Suite
Moodboards
Presentations
Layouts
Visual references
Creative treatments
On-set problem solving

You do not need to execute every asset yourself.

But you must understand the craft deeply enough to elevate every piece of work.







THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You can walk into a room with designers, marketers, photographers, editors, producers, agencies and external partners and speak everyone’s language.

You understand that your role is to protect the brand, elevate execution and create clarity for the entire creative organization.

You have:

Exceptional visual taste
Strong art direction skills
A portfolio showing both concept understanding and execution excellence
Experience leading shoots and visual productions
Experience working with multidisciplinary creative teams
Strong project and creative workflow management skills
The ability to prioritize multiple creative initiatives simultaneously
Experience managing agencies, freelancers or external production partners
A strong understanding of social-first creative
High cultural awareness
Excellent communication and feedback skills
Strong organizational instincts
High attention to detail
The ability to move between thinking and making
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish

Experience in beauty, fashion, lifestyle or culturally driven brands is highly valued.

You can zoom out to understand the brand and zoom in to question a crop, a typeface, a transition or a layout decision.

Most importantly, you know how to take a creative vision, understand its intention, and make sure it is executed at the highest possible standard across every touchpoint—while enabling teams to move faster and more independently.







HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS

Within your first 6 months:

Creative consistency

Anna’s creative vision is clearly and consistently translated across campaign, social, retail and digital outputs.

Execution quality

The overall standard of visual execution across the team improves noticeably.

Creative autonomy

Day-to-day creative execution can move forward with minimal Creative Director intervention, with teams confidently operating within established creative standards.

Creative Studio effectiveness

The Creative Studio operates with clear priorities, efficient workflows and balanced resource allocation, resulting in fewer bottlenecks and stronger on-time delivery.

Team elevation

Designers and content creatives become more confident in executing the vision independently, while agencies and external partners receive clearer direction and require fewer revision rounds.

Creative Director leverage

Anna spends significantly more time on vision, concepting and innovation rather than execution oversight, creative triage and day-to-day decision making.







APPLICATION

A portfolio will requested to apply to this role. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of:

Art direction and campaign work
Photography and/or video productions
Social-first creative
Brand and visual identity execution
Projects where you translated a creative concept across multiple touchpoints
Your specific role and contribution to each project

About the job

Operations & Product Support Coordinator

 Customer Support & Operations · Fintech / AI · Mexico · Remote, US hours




About the Company

My client is a US technology company building an AI platform for B2B loan servicing and legal collections. Commercial lenders, fintechs, and financial institutions use the platform to automate up to 90% of their servicing and legal workflows, from borrower communications all the way through UCC filing and enforcement.




The platform runs AI agents across voice, SMS, and email, connects directly to the client's loan management system, and layers in automated legal action with a network of attorneys. Compliance is built into the core, from FDCPA to state regulations, with full audit trails on every action. Customers report recovery rate improvements of up to 30%.




About the Role

This is a support-first seat at the center of a fast-moving fintech product. You will become the in-house expert on the platform, take care of the lenders who use it every day, and be the bridge between what customers need and what the product team builds.

Most of your week is customer facing: calls, questions, and requests from a portfolio of roughly 10 to 15 accounts. The rest is the work that keeps those customers happy behind the scenes: writing up issues as clear tickets, tracking them through to resolution, and closing the loop. You will also lend a hand to the marketing team when you have the bandwidth, which is a nice way to see more of how the business runs.

The core skill: answering "can the product do this for the customer?" accurately and quickly. That means learning the platform deeply, knowing its limits, and routing what it cannot do yet to the product team as a clear, well-written ticket.




What You'll Do

Own your accounts. Roughly 10 to 15 lenders, day to day, including scheduled calls. You are their person.
Handle support and product questions over calls, email, and chat, resolving what you can directly and escalating what you cannot.
Learn the platform inside and out. You will be trained on the internal software and become the person who knows what it can and cannot do. Expect a week or two to get there.
Write clear, well-structured tickets capturing the customer issue, the expected behavior, and how to reproduce it.
Track tickets end to end in Linear, following up until they are resolved and closing the loop with the customer.
Educate customers and build the relationship. Walk people through features, get them using more of the platform, and keep them confident in it.
Be the voice of the customer with product. Flag patterns and recurring requests, test new features, and feed real usage back into the roadmap.
Lend a hand to marketing. Most marketing runs through an AI tool, so this is light support when you have room: social posts, content coordination, the occasional campaign. Not the core of the job, but a real part of the week.
General operations support: internal coordination, documentation, and process work as the team scales.




What You Bring

2+ years in customer support, operations, customer success, or a similar coordination role, ideally at a software or technology company.
Fluent English (C1/C2), written and spoken. You will be on calls with US financial services customers. What matters most is communicating clearly and thinking well, not a perfect accent.
Strong written communication. A vague ticket costs engineering hours, so precision matters.
Technical curiosity. You do not need to code. You do need to genuinely enjoy learning how software works and being the person with the answer.
Organization under volume. Multiple customers, multiple open tickets, nothing dropped.
High agency and ownership. This is a pioneering seat on a small team. Nobody will hand you a checklist every morning.
Discretion. You will handle sensitive customer and borrower data in a regulated industry. Trustworthiness is not optional here.




One thing we screen for: you actually use AI

This team builds with AI and expects you to as well. We will ask you the same question they will: what is the coolest thing you have built or automated using AI tools?

It does not have to be work. A personal project, a workflow you automated, an assistant you wired up for yourself, all count. What we are listening for is that you have actually gone and made something, not that you have read about it.




Nice to Have

Experience with Linear, Jira, Notion, or similar ticketing and project tools. Linear is easy to pick up, so this is a head start rather than a requirement.
Familiarity with APIs and integrations, or comfort reading logs.
Background in fintech, lending, banking, financial services, or collections. Genuinely not required, curiosity about the space matters more.
Interest in financial markets or AI products.
Some marketing range: social content, copywriting, or campaign coordination. Helpful for the marketing support side of the role.

title: CONTENT CAPTURE — MENTIRAS
description:
About the job

Objetivo del puesto




Responsable de realizar el levantamiento y captura de contenido audiovisual durante las funciones, eventos y actividades de Mentiras, generando material suficiente, atractivo y de calidad para que posteriormente el equipo de Marketing y Diseño pueda utilizarlo en redes sociales, campañas y comunicación de la marca.




El puesto está enfocado exclusivamente en la captura de contenido. No contempla edición de video, diseño, publicación, calendarización, community management ni desarrollo de estrategia de contenidos.




Responsabilidades principales




• Asistir a las funciones asignadas para realizar levantamiento de contenido.

• Capturar fotografía y video vertical principalmente con celular y/o equipo asignado.

• Documentar momentos relevantes antes, durante y después de cada función.

• Generar contenido de:

• Escenas y momentos destacados de la función.

• Elenco en escenario.

• Backstage cuando sea requerido.

• Llegada y salida de artistas.

• Ambiente del teatro.

• Público y experiencia de los asistentes.

• Activaciones, invitados especiales y eventos.

• Detalles de escenografía, vestuario y elementos visuales.

• Momentos espontáneos que puedan funcionar para redes sociales.

• Seguir un shot list o brief previamente establecido por el equipo de Marketing/Diseño.

• Tener criterio para detectar momentos adicionales que puedan convertirse en contenido atractivo.

• Realizar diferentes tipos de tomas de un mismo momento: generales, medias, detalles, movimientos, POV, reacciones, etc.

• Cuidar encuadre, iluminación, estabilidad y calidad del material.

• Entregar y organizar correctamente todos los archivos generados después de cada función.

• Identificar el material por fecha, función, elenco o categoría para facilitar su uso posterior.

• Mantener comunicación con el equipo para conocer prioridades específicas de cada función.




Perfil ideal




• Buen ojo visual y sensibilidad estética.

• Conocimiento de composición, encuadre e iluminación.

• Experiencia grabando contenido vertical para redes sociales.

• Capacidad para capturar contenido dinámico en condiciones de poca luz.

• Rapidez para detectar momentos relevantes.

• Discreción y capacidad para trabajar alrededor de artistas y backstage.

• Organización para manejo y entrega de archivos.

• Disponibilidad principalmente en horarios de función, incluyendo noches y fines de semana.

• Capacidad para seguir briefs y shot lists.

• Conocimiento del lenguaje actual de Instagram, TikTok y contenido digital desde el punto de vista visual, sin necesidad de administrar las plataformas.




Entregables por función




Al finalizar cada cobertura deberá entregar:




• Material de video original.

• Fotografías realizadas durante la cobertura.

• Tomas solicitadas en el shot list.

• Material adicional generado de manera espontánea.

• Archivos organizados y correctamente identificados.




OBLIGATORIO: NO HABER PARTICIPADO PREVIAMENTE EN NINGÚN PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN DE MENTIRAS BRAND, MENTIRAS EL MÚSICAL, MENTIRAS LA MERCH, MENTIDRAGS, LATE PRODUCCIONES, CTR PRODUCCIONES. +4 AÑOS DE EXPERIENCIA




CONTRATACIÓN INMEDIATA. SOLO POSTULARSE SI SE CUMPLE ESTRICTAMENTE CON EL PERFIL

description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.
